content.title: Welcome to the "Twisted Ark Servers"
content.text:
Welcome to the "Twisted Ark Servers".

Claim your free Remote Teleporter and Snow owl in our F1 shop.
Click "Packs" select the pack and buy it. (free) then claim it in the "Loot" tab.

Be sure to check out all our information by visiting our Discord.

Most important Rules.

All Players must be in a tribe and need to register their tribe on our Discord.

Your Tribe name must remain the same on all Servers across our cluster.

Absolutely no Greifing. If you have an issue with another player... Contact admin... retaliation is Not okay.

NO PILLAR SPAMMING!!!

content.title: Server Rates
content.text:
Taming: 20

Breeding: x20

Mature: x20

Harvest: x5

We also have potions and tranqs to make taming simpler.

content.title: Ark Shop
content.text:
1. Press F1 to access the shop

2. You earn 15 shop points for every 15 consecutive minutes you play.

3. When you purchase a Pack, you must then claim it from the Loot tab

4. All mutated dino's must be neutered before sale.

5. shop points are able to be traded for Player trade coins in the  "Pack" tab

content.title: Player Trade
content.text:
1. All "Players" may have 2 personal trade shops on each server.

2. All "Tribes" may have 2 personal Trade shops on each server.

3. All mutated dino's must be neutered before sale.

4. Player trade coins are able to be traded for shop points in the  "Sell" tab
